License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Large printed fascia banner of a halal poultry shop in El Socorro, Trinidad (no camera location), shot from a moving car: motion blur and an oblique angle. 'Halaal Village' is in outlined script on a red arrow. A smaller line under it (looks like 'Next to El Socorro Masjid' plus a WhatsApp number) is too blurred to transcribe reliably and is omitted. Product lists ('FRESH CHICKEN / FARM DUCKS / LOCAL DUCKS / HARD FOWL', 'X-LAYERS / FRESH EGGS ...'), a red 'NO ENTRY' road sign and a chalkboard 'Farm Ducks / Local Ducks / X-LAYERS' are distractors.
source_title: File:Halal poultry shop in El Socorro, Trinidad opposite Nur E Islam Masjid with sign advertising local ducks and chickens.jpg

author: 999real

Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%22The_Mahdi_Has_Appeared%22_sign_from_Ahmadi_Religion_of_Peace_and_Light_on_walkover_on_the_Churchill_Roosevelt_highway_in_El_Socorro_Trinidad.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue overhead lane-destination panels on a pedestrian overpass across the Churchill Roosevelt Highway at El Socorro (no camera location), shot through a car windscreen. Target is the middle panel 'UBH / Arima' with an airport pictogram and down arrow (UBH = Uriah Butler Highway). Neighbouring panels: left 'UBH / Bamboo', right 'S’ Grande / Arima' (curly apostrophe, abbreviation of Sangre Grande) with airport pictogram. Distractors: a '5m' height-clearance triangle and a religious banner 'THE MAHDI HAS APPEARED' with Arabic on the railing above.
source_title: File:"The Mahdi Has Appeared" sign from Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light on walkover on the Churchill Roosevelt highway in El Socorro Trinidad.jpg
source_categories: Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light

notes: White letters painted on the red roof of the port terminal building in Scarborough, Tobago (camera 11.11, -60.44), seen from the sea at a distance; 'WELCOME TO THE' on the upper gable, 'PORT OF SCARBOROUGH' along the lower roof slope. The photographer added a small red caption 'Scarborough / Tobago / West Indies' at the top-left corner; it is an overlay, not part of the sign. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Ports and harbours in Trinidad and Tobago

author: Rajkumar 1 02
attribution: Photo: Rajkumar 1 02, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kelly_Village,_Trinidad_and_Tobago.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green welcome panel with white letters and left/right arrows on either side of 'VILLAGE', set in a stone pillar by a shelter, Kelly Village (camera 10.5849, -61.3548); slightly soft focus, taken through a car window. The faded red fascia text on the shelter roof above is unreadable; billboards at right are cut off. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arimaboss
attribution: Photo: Arimaboss, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WelcomeToDebeSign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Ornamental arch with raised serif letters spanning the main road in Debe (camera 10.2176, -61.4580), shot through a windscreen; the whole image is soft but the arch text is clear. Distractors: blurred shop signs and billboards down the street; car plates are small and incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

attribution: Photo: Grueslayer, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:TnT_Debe_Town_Sign_2.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Dark green town-limit board with cream letters in a green/yellow pipe frame on a grass verge in Debe (camera 10.2153, -61.4539); night flash shot, frontal and sharp. The Welcome to Debe arch (c71817632) is faintly visible far in the background; a Rotary International wheel and a blue 'PENAL' sign fragment are at the top right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: TOBAGO HOUSE OF ASSEMBLY DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM

notes: Large white beach board with a blue title band, Englishman's Bay, Tobago (no camera location); frontal. The apostrophe is typographic (’). Below the transcribed lines is advisory text ('USERS OF THIS BEACH ARE ADVISED: THIS BEACH IS NOT PATROLLED BY LIFEGUARDS / SECURITY ...'), not transcribed. Distractors: 'TOBAGO DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM' round logo, and a weathered 'TOBAGO HOUSE OF ASSEMBLY ... WARNING DANGEROUS TREE MANCHINEEL TREE ...' board at left.
